data.exact_reserve_text: The loss for the year ended 31 December 2014 is GBP 16.0m. The loss is mainly due to deteriorations in Dutch Hospital business in the Medical Malpractice class, Australian Binder in the General Liability class, sports sector in the Personal Accident class and reduction in Medical Malpractice reinsurance recoverables which collectively resulted in additional losses of GBP 27.7m.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Net claims provisions for Italian Public Hospitals on the 2007 & prior years of account decreased from GBP 127million in 2013 to GBP 104.6million in 2014.
The board of MMA resolved to close the 2012 year of account at a loss of GBP 6.3m.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross reserve strengthening of GBP 27.7 million for prior underwriting years, primarily driven by deteriorations in Dutch Hospital business (Medical Malpractice), Australian Binder (General Liability), and the sports sector (Personal Accident), alongside a reduction in Medical Malpractice reinsurance recoverables. This adverse development was partially offset by a GBP 22.4 million release from Italian Public Hospitals claims for the 2007 and prior years of account. Additionally, the 2012 year of account was closed at a loss of GBP 6.3 million.
